capabilities.description: Move the Piper end-effector site (ee_site) to a specified world-frame target position and hold it at termination.
capabilities.effect: ee_site reaches the requested xyz within the position tolerance at the end of the motion.

target_xyz.description: World-frame target position [x, y, z] in metres for ee_site.

preconditions: target_xyz is within the robot reachable workspace.
No joint limit violation is expected along the IK solution path.
invariants: Joint positions remain within ctrlrange throughout motion.
ee_site identity is preserved (site attached to link6).
capabilities.failure_behavior: If IK fails or workspace limit is exceeded, the arm halts at the last feasible configuration and reports failure.

criteria.metric: Euclidean distance between ee_site world position and target_xyz at motion termination.

source_refs.specific_reference: metaworld/envs/sawyer_reach_v3.py, evaluate_state lines 74-98: success is reach_dist <= 0.05.
source_refs.adaptation: Retain the 0.05 m Euclidean endpoint obligation applied to Piper ee_site.

capabilities.description: Move the Piper ee_site through an ordered sequence of 2 to 4 world-frame waypoints, visiting each in order.
capabilities.effect: ee_site visits each waypoint in the declared order; the recorded path satisfies the ordered trajectory criterion.

waypoints_xyz.description: Ordered list of 2-4 world-frame [x, y, z] waypoints in metres for ee_site.

duration_s.description: Total allowed motion duration in seconds (default 6.0).

preconditions: All waypoints are within the robot reachable workspace.
Consecutive waypoints are reachable without joint-limit violation.
invariants: Waypoints are visited in the declared order.
Joint positions remain within ctrlrange throughout.
capabilities.failure_behavior: If any waypoint is unreachable, the arm halts at the last feasible waypoint and reports failure.

criteria.metric: Ordered trajectory matching error: maximum Euclidean distance between ee_site path and each declared waypoint in sequence.

source_refs.specific_reference: metaworld/envs/sawyer_push_v3.py line 31 and evaluate_state lines 88-112: TARGET_RADIUS 0.05 m; sawyer_push_wall_v3.py evaluate_state lines 88-119: 0.07 m.
source_refs.adaptation: Proposed 0.05 m per-waypoint tolerance for ordered EE traversal; tightest source bound used.

capabilities.description: Set the Piper gripper slide position (joint7) to a target value in [0.0, 0.035] m; 0.0 m is fully closed, 0.035 m is fully open.
capabilities.effect: joint7 reaches the requested slide position at termination; joint8 mirrors via equality constraint.

aperture_m.description: Target gripper slide position in metres: 0.0 = closed, 0.035 = fully open.

preconditions: No external force prevents gripper motion.
capabilities.failure_behavior: If the gripper is blocked by contact, it holds at the contact position and reports partial success.

criteria.metric: Absolute error between joint7 position and aperture_m at termination.

source_refs.specific_reference: Piper gripper actuator ctrlrange [0.0, 0.035] m; proposed 0.003 m tolerance (~8.6% of full range).
source_refs.adaptation: Proposed tolerance for gripper slide position accuracy; no direct source benchmark criterion.

capabilities.description: Set the Piper joint6 wrist-roll angle to a target value within [-3.14, 3.14] rad.
capabilities.effect: joint6 reaches the requested angle at termination.

angle_rad.description: Target joint6 wrist-roll angle in radians.

preconditions: angle_rad is within joint6 ctrlrange [-3.14, 3.14] rad.
No self-collision is expected at the target angle.
invariants: Arm joints 1-5 remain at their current positions during wrist roll.
capabilities.failure_behavior: If the target angle is outside ctrlrange, the joint is clamped to the nearest limit.

criteria.metric: Absolute error between joint6 position and angle_rad at termination.

source_refs.specific_reference: Piper joint6 ctrlrange [-3.14, 3.14] rad; proposed 0.05 rad (~2.9 deg) terminal accuracy.
source_refs.adaptation: Proposed wrist-roll terminal accuracy; no direct source benchmark criterion for joint angle.

capabilities.description: Move the Piper ee_site to a contact approach position, then push/pull to a tool-target position, maintaining contact force during the push phase.
capabilities.effect: ee_site reaches contact_xyz, then moves to push_xyz; positive contact normal force is sustained during the push phase.

contact_xyz.description: World-frame [x, y, z] position in metres where ee_site first makes contact.

push_xyz.description: World-frame [x, y, z] terminal position in metres for ee_site after the push/pull motion.

duration_s.description: Total allowed motion duration in seconds (default 4.0).

preconditions: contact_xyz and push_xyz are within the robot reachable workspace.
A scene object or surface is present at contact_xyz to generate contact force.
invariants: Joint positions remain within ctrlrange throughout.
capabilities.failure_behavior: If contact is not established at contact_xyz, the arm continues to push_xyz and reports zero contact force.

criteria.metric: Euclidean distance between ee_site world position and push_xyz at motion termination.

source_refs.adaptation: Apply 0.05 m terminal EE position tolerance to the push endpoint.

criteria.metric: Peak contact normal force between ee geom and scene contact surface during the push phase.

source_refs.specific_reference: Contact-based push tasks require physical contact; proposed 0.1 N minimum peak force to confirm contact was established.
source_refs.adaptation: Proposed minimum contact force threshold to verify physical contact during push motion.

Push requires contact force at contact_position; ee_contact_push measures contact normal force.

grasp_wrist_roll sets joint6 for stable grasp orientation; wrist_roll controls joint6.
